name: Fluxus intermedia composition
lineage: International intermedia-art movement (1962-1978 active period, lingering influences thereafter) founded by George Maciunas, including composer-artists George Brecht, La Monte Young, Yoko Ono, Nam June Paik, and Alison Knowles. Compositional output centered on event-scores (brief text-instructions for actions), conceptual-musical-performance, and the deliberate dissolution of boundaries between music, theatre, visual art, and life-art. Brecht's Drip Music (1959) and Young's Compositions 1960 series constitute the canonical type-specimens.
